WITH state_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    p.death_state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT h.player_id) as count
  FROM hall_of_fame h
  INNER JOIN player p ON h.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY p.death_state
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(count) as avg_val
  FROM state_counts
),
filtered_states AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.count,
    oa.avg_val
  FROM state_counts sc
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE sc.count > oa.avg_val
)
SELECT 
  AVG(count) as avg_count,
  AVG(count - avg_val) as avg_excess
FROM filtered_states
